mapper.sql: p.id, p.name, p.category_id, p.description, p.price, p.original_price, p.stock, p.sales, p.main_image, p.images, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT , c.name as category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (name, category_id, description, price, original_price, stock, sales, main_image, images, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{description}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{stock}, #{sales}, #{mainImage}, #{images}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
